cross_item_pattern.rule: In Conflicting-Viewpoints items whose stem gives a new finding and whose options each read '<scientist/hypothesis>, because <scientist> says X', the key is the option whose because-clause restates the finding's own content (same quantity, same direction). Distractor clauses are either irrelevant to the finding or state its opposite. Applied without the viewpoints it picks the key on 5 of 5 (chance 1.25), across 4 passages in both forms.
